name: Sony BRAVIA KD-55XF7596
summary: Sony BRAVIA KD-55XF7596 ships with an ACR viewing tracker, Sony ads and a retail demo. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This 2018 Sony set runs Android TV 9 and has only about 200 MB of memory free with the stock home screen. It ships with a viewing tracker that identifies what is on screen, Sony and Google content, ads and promos, a retail demo, telemetry and remote support, and preloaded help apps.

The list was applied in six batches, checking Home, Netflix, HDMI 1 and the DVB-T input after each. After a restart all 38 apps were still off, and nothing came back or crashed. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Sony input, Bravia Sync, remote pairing and tuner services
Sony IP control, which Home Assistant uses
The Play Store, Play Services and Gboard
Live TV and the HDMI inputs (the Sony TV app)
notes: The stock home screen ignores a new home screen setting until it is switched off.
The YouView, HbbTV and a few other apps are left alone and have not been tested.

faq.q: Will Home Assistant still work with my Sony?
faq.a: Yes. Sony IP control is kept on purpose.

faq.q: Do the changes survive a restart?
faq.a: Yes. After a restart all 38 apps were still off, and nothing crashed.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
